answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in an escrow before it can earn: the stake acts as an inlet filter, so one operator spinning up thousands of identities must fund each one separately, and the attack cost scales linearly with the number of fakes. Honest agents get the stake back with earnings, while a grove of fake identities caught coordinating gets slashed together, so the attacker loses the whole deposit at once. Add slow reputation that only accrues through verified work over weeks, not a whisper of activity, so fresh identities earn almost nothing until they prove themselves.
